questions.q: What is the first signal that something is wrong in this lesson?
options: A compile error in the Glue ETL script
Finance reports stale numbers, or the northfield-redshift-load job shows a failed overnight run
The Redshift Serverless workgroup is deleted
A quiz question fails to load
questions.explain: The incident surfaces either through a stakeholder report (stale numbers) or directly via the failed scheduled job.

questions.q: What is the first job once the report comes in, before investigating any specific cause?
options: Immediately rewrite the IAM role's policy
Reproduce the failure yourself, under known conditions
Delete and recreate the fact_orders table
Assume the S3 curated zone is corrupted and re-run the whole ETL job
questions.explain: The course's consistent diagnostic discipline is reproduce first, then investigate — never guess and act before confirming the problem is real.

questions.q: Why run the Lesson 5 COPY statement manually instead of just reading the Glue job's log?
options: It rules out anything specific to the scheduled trigger itself and isolates the question to the COPY operation alone
Glue jobs don't produce logs
Manual COPY statements run faster than scheduled ones
It's required by AWS billing policy
questions.explain: Running the real statement by hand separates a possible EventBridge/Glue trigger issue from a problem with the COPY itself.

questions.q: What does the error message "Load into table 'fact_orders' failed. Check 'sys_load_error_detail'..." actually tell you?
options: The exact root cause and the fix to apply
That the failure is confirmed and reproducible, but not yet what specifically caused it
That the S3 bucket was deleted
That the IAM role was deleted
questions.explain: The message is generic by design — it confirms something broke and points you at a system table, without stating the specific cause.

questions.q: What does this lesson explicitly warn against doing at this stage?
options: Running the COPY statement at all
Jumping to a guess like 'the IAM role probably expired' instead of confirming the cause systematically
Reporting the incident to Finance
Using the Redshift Query Editor
questions.explain: Acting on an unconfirmed guess risks fixing something that was never broken while the real cause stays in place.
